# The arrival of a_usd_arrival_booked_to_the_directors_account.txt with a
# third split, 0.00 CAD on the director's account with no value stated, for
# `--strategy update`. GnuCash leaves such splits in a transaction. Its amount
# and value are both zero, so the rate the cost basis is priced at is what it
# was, and the edit goes through.
#
# ..._moved_to_income_keeping_the_zero_amount_cad_split.txt then moves the other
# Canadian dollar split to income and keeps this one as it is.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
